description: Unit test class for testing table rendering features in MigraDoc, including borders, cell merging, and vertical alignment.

classes.name: TestTable
classes.description: Contains static methods to test table rendering functionalities such as borders, cell merging, and vertical alignment.

methods.name: Borders
methods.description: Creates a document with a table that has visible borders and saves it to the specified output file.

methods.name: CellMerge
methods.description: Creates a document with a table demonstrating cell merging (right and down) and saves it.

methods.description: Creates a table with vertically aligned cells and saves the document.
